patthana11.15:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na paṇītaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... namicchattattika nakusalattikaṃ na micchattaniyataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.15:3.1: sammattaniyataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na aniyataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... namaggārammaṇattika nakusalattikaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.15:5.1: na maggahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na maggādhipatiṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nauppannattika nakusalattikaṃ na anuppannaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.15:7.1: na uppādiṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naatītattika nakusalattikaṃ na atītaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na anāgataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana11.15:9.1: atītārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na anāgatārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na paccuppannārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana11.15:11.1: ajjhattaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na bahiddhā na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naajjhattārammaṇattika nakusalattikaṃ na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.15:13.1: bahiddhārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasanidassanattika nakusalattikaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na
